verdict.rationale: Auth0 documents an official CLI (auth0-cli) for managing tenant configuration, automating tasks, and integrating into dev/deployment workflows, corroborated by an official GitHub repo, which fits the 'ai-native user wants official CLI' story for a platform product. Missing for 10: independent hands-on review of the CLI's AI-native ergonomics and no evidence of AI-specific CLI features (e.g., natural-language CLI usage) beyond the separate MCP server offering.
